# Karthik Nandiraju

> Hi, I’m Karthik, living in Silicon Valley, and I’m passionate about helping peop

Hi, I’m Karthik, living in Silicon Valley, and I’m passionate about helping people in need. Having lived in both the U.S. and India, I’ve gained a deep understanding of the challenges faced by kids without proper family or financial support. It’s close to my heart to use my experiences to make a difference in their lives, offering them hope and opportunities to thrive. Helping others inspires me, and I believe even small efforts can create a big impact.
